messages:
Rae: Heads up — got customer report: sudden token spike correlated with streaming toolcall truncation + client auto-replay. Looks like provisional ledger keeps both entries.
Omar: Can you paste session id/logs?
Rae: sess=tx9-77; logs:
```
WARN worker-9: session=tx9-77 event=STREAM_TRUNCATED toolcall_id=tcA offset=1280
INFO router-1: session=tx9-77 route=fast-region provisional_credits=120 toolcall_id=tcA
INFO proxy-5: session=tx9-77 event=CLIENT_RECONNECT replay=true new_toolcall_id=tcB provisional_credits=124
```
Priya: So tcA stayed provisional=false->committed=false while tcB committed=true. UI shows both => inflated charge in that hour. 
Zoe: Why don't we dedupe on (session, offset, tool_name)? Aren't toolcall ids ephemeral?
Priya: Exactly. toolcall_id is per-execution so not stable across trunc+replay. We currently dedupe streams via (session, offset) but toolcalls are separate rows.
Omar: Proposal: augment provisional entries with `origin_key` computed as `hash(session_id + first_offset + trace_id || client_request_id)` when toolcall starts. Replays that share origin_key link to same provisional slot. 
Rae: That depends on clients sending a stable request id. Not always available. Could we fall back to a temporal heuristic: if replay happens within 10s and offset matches, consider same origin.
Priya: That seems reasonable. Edge: legitimate new toolcall within 10s could be merged erroneously. But we can emit low-confidence flag. 
Zoe: For the console: show a visual grouping for provisional overlaps, with collective token count and a "combine" action that allows ops to collapse grouped provisional entries for billing display (not altering ledger commit). Also add a tooltip explaining why grouping happened. 
billing-bot: created provisional_group pg-99 for sess=tx9-77 candidates=[tcA,tcB] reason=trunc_replay confidence=0.62
Omar: Backend change: add provisional_group_id nullable, with metadata {source: heuristic, confidence, created_by}. We'll only annotate, not change commit pipeline in first pass. 
Priya: Tests: simulate truncate mid-toolcall, then client reconnect with immediate replay. Assert UI groups entries, metrics provisional_overlap increments, and final_committed tokens == tokens_of_committed_entry (no double-charge). 
Rae: On reconciliation: committed events already mark toolcall ids as final; billing reconciler should sum only committed entries and ignore provisional stray rows older than X that never commit. But currently reconciler counts committed entries only; issue is spike in provisional shown in console and spikes in provisional-based alerts. 
Zoe: So short-term: UX/telemetry fix (grouping + metric). Medium-term: add origin_key propagation to router/worker. Long-term: change reconciliation to prefer collapsing commits to a canonical origin when present. 
Omar: Rollout plan: feature flag for origin_key in router; enable on staging, run replay flood test. If stable, roll to 10% prod. 
Rae: I'll run query to find top 25 sessions with >1 provisional per toolcall in last 30d and tag customers. 
Priya: Also add a console banner: "Showing provisional entries — some may be duplicates due to in-flight truncation/replay. Click to group." 
Rae: Ok. I'll open ticket billing-dup-provisional and attach logs + pg-99. 
Omar: lgtm, ping when canary ready. 
Rae: Thanks everyone. :wave:
